description: This file defines a ContactsHandler class along with related data classes and an implementation of the ContactsDataSource interface for Android. It provides functionality for searching and adding contacts to the device contacts database, handling permissions, and serializing/deserializing contact data in JSON format.

classes.name: ContactRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a contact with identifier, display name, name components, organization, phone numbers, and emails.

classes.name: ContactsSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class for specifying search query and limit when searching for contacts.

classes.name: ContactsAddRequest
classes.description: Data class representing the information needed to add a new contact.

classes.name: ContactsDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission checks, searching, and adding contacts.

classes.name: SystemContactsDataSource
classes.description: Implementation of ContactsDataSource that interacts with Android's ContactsProvider to perform contact operations.

classes.name: ContactsHandler
classes.description: Main class handling contact search and add requests, managing permissions, and serializing responses.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to read contacts.

methods.name: hasWritePermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to write contacts.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches the contacts database based on the provided request, returning matching contact records.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new contact to the contacts database based on the provided request.

methods.name: loadContactRecord
methods.description: Constructs a ContactRecord object from data loaded from the contacts database.

methods.name: handleContactsSearch
methods.description: Handles a contact search request, returning JSON results or error messages.

methods.name: handleContactsAdd
methods.description: Handles a request to add a contact, returning the created contact as JSON or an error message.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a ContactsSearchRequest object.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to create a ContactsAddRequest object.

methods.name: stringArray
methods.description: Converts a JsonArray into a List of trimmed strings.
